kpis.definition: On-time = every lot of the order reached the customer gate by promised_at + grace. Orders still in transit are excluded.
kpis.warning_lead_time_note: promised_at minus first HIGH alert, for lots predicted late or breached. Baseline assumption: without the tool, customers learn at the breach (lead time 0).

reasons.explains: mean contribution (hours) versus the deterministic baseline; P50/P90 are shown separately
reasons.method: Monte Carlo, N=500. Probabilities carry a sampling error of up to about 2.2 percentage points. Assumed distributions; not a trained ML model.
notes: Transporter variability factor x1.15 (widens the range, not the mean)
